// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MUTATION-MODULE
// School is ADULT_READABLE, and update is one of its permitted call shapes, so
// before PR4 this was a clean pass in the READ chokepoint. That is the hole the
// new rule closes: which model may be written is a different question from
// where the write may live, and "every mutating action is in the frozen
// registry" is only true if the build refuses one that is not.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function renameSchool(schoolId, name) {
  await db.school.update({ where: { id: schoolId }, data: { name }, select: { id: true } });
}
